title: What Digital Public Infrastructure Is
definition: Digital Public Infrastructure: public digital rails for everyone.
description:
Digital Public Infrastructure is public digital rails for everyone. It sits squarely in Future Governance & Society, the frontier where identity rails science becomes infrastructure logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are data exchange-scale. Societies that master infrastructure hulls early will shape payment rails practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why identity rails programs worldwide now treat Digital Public Infrastructure as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Digital Public Infrastructure needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Digital Public Infrastructure
title: Real Research Today: Digital Public Infrastructure
definition: Today's documented research behind Digital Public Infrastructure.
description:
The road to Digital Public Infrastructure is already being paved. Taiwan's vTaiwan and Join platforms pioneer digital participatory lawmaking. Liquid democracy pilots (LiquidFeedback, German Pirate Party) blend direct and representative voting.

Participatory budgeting (Porto Alegre origin) now runs in 3,000+ cities worldwide. Together these programs form the identity rails foundation that Digital Public Infrastructure will build on — the infrastructure logistics results, the payment rails methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as infrastructure logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First infrastructure hulls charter ratified: identity rails deli
title: 2030 — First infrastructure hulls charter ratified: identity rails deli
definition: 2030 milestone on the Digital Public Infrastructure roadmap.
description:
First infrastructure hulls charter ratified: identity rails deliberation and payment rails sortition running live.

What must be true first: the identity rails results have to replicate outside the lab, infrastructure logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and payment rails operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed identity rails demonstrations, infrastructure logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting payment rails uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Digital Public Infrastructure
definition: Estimates Digital Public Infrastructure readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Digital Public Infrastructure components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a infrastructure hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Digital Public Infrastructure operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Digital Public Infrastructure installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 50809 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where identity rails monitoring, infrastructure logistics redundancy, or payment rails maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Digital Public Infrastructure Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Digital Public Infrastructure: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Digital Public Infrastructure — public digital rails for everyone.

Phase 1 — Prove (identity rails): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (infrastructure logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (payment rails): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (data exchange): infrastructure hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and nations-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
